proposals.title: Special Shareholder Meeting Improvement - Proposal 5
proposals.topic_summary: Amend governing documents to give owners of a combined 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareholder meeting.
proposals.evidence: Accordingly, the Board of Directors recommends that Abbott's shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Independent Board Chairman - Proposal 6
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt policy requiring separate Chairman and CEO, with the Chairman being an independent director whenever possible.
proposals.evidence: For these reasons, the Board of Directors recommends that Abbott's shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Lobbying Disclosure
proposals.proponent: The Province of Saint Joseph of the Capuchin Order and Proxy Impact, on behalf of Hilary E. Van Dusen
proposals.topic_summary: Prepare annual report disclosing lobbying policies, payments for direct, indirect and grassroots lobbying, trade association payments, and oversight.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that Abbott's shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Incentive Compensation
proposals.proponent: Shareholder Association for Research & Education, on behalf of HLB Investments ULC
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt policy that no financial performance metric be adjusted to exclude legal or compliance costs when determining senior executive incentive awards.
proposals.evidence: For these reasons, the Board of Directors recommends that Abbott's shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.
